$description: Real-company protection. Hashes only: the repo never stores terms.so's proprietary long-form text. semantic_validate.py rejects any PageSpec string (or sentence of >= 5 words) whose fingerprint matches; verify_all.py checks no repo file contains it.

covers: home: footer description (whole + sentences), meta description (whole + sentences), page title (8 hashes, v1.0.0)

v1.1.0: every long-form

/

  • / block (whole + sentences of >= 5 words) on the live /about, /pricing, /changelog, /docs, /privacy and /terms, fetched 2026-10-21 and hashed at build time; the text was never written to disk in the repo (990 hashes; per page blocks/sentences: about 10/31, changelog 125/185, docs 42/142, pricing 2/8, privacy 69/190, terms 67/193)
copyFingerprints.excludedFromHashing: verbatim short UI that the spec allows (headings, table header labels, changelog entry titles, link-only blocks such as TOC entries)

sourceDomainsNote: terms.so plus the live About/changelog links to the operator's studio, its founder's site and its source repository: real third parties a generated page must not link to
shortCopyPolicy: Short UI copy (headings, labels, demo strings) from the measured home page is used verbatim in schema/example.pagespec.json as a reference instance. The sub-route examples (schema/examples/) use only short UI strings (headings, labels, plan names, dates, entry titles) or original text. A generated page for another brand should write its own copy within the same budgets.
longFormPolicy: Sub-route long-form (About paragraphs and table cells, changelog bodies, docs paragraphs, all legal text) is contracted by structure and budgets only. Never source it from the live site; the clone's own long-form is original placeholder copy.
